description: Step 2: put an uploaded file (runzero_volume_import_link) onto the persistent volume. The service stops, the current data is backed up first, the file is placed, and the service starts again. Existing data is only replaced with overwrite: true; ask the user before setting it. An SQLite file is checked first, and the old -wal/-shm of the file it replaces are removed. Takes minutes; follow it with runzero_volume_status (`restore.phase` ends at `done`, with `error` if it failed and the data stayed unchanged).

overwrite.description: Replace an existing file, or for an archive the current content of the volume

target.description: Single file only: path inside the volume, relative or under the mount path (default: the file name at the top)

name: runzero_import_volume
title: Import into volume
